Перейдите в каталог `~/pool-inventory`.

:::{#exr-lab-libvirt-storage-pools-pool-inventory}
#### Инвентаризация storage pools

Создайте `env.sh`:

```bash
POOL_NAME=lab-pool
POOL_DIR=/tmp/libvirt-lab-pool
```

Сохраните вывод:

```bash
sudo -n virsh -c qemu:///system pool-list --all > pool-list-all.txt
sudo -n virsh -c qemu:///system pool-list --all --details > pool-list-details.txt
sudo -n virsh -c qemu:///system pool-info default > pool-info-default.txt 2>&1 || echo 'default pool is absent' > pool-info-default.txt
```
:::
